messages.text: *Hearken, mortal!* By the stroke of 14:00, the sacred Zammad Docker scrolls must be inscribed, lest the container demons consume thy soul.
*Hark, mortal!* By the stroke of 12:00, have the Zammad Docker scrolls inscribed, or face the eternal wrath of the deployment demons!
*Hark, mortal!* By the tenth bell of the clockwork, summon the Zammad container from the Docker abyss, lest the ancient scrolls of documentation remain unwritten!
*Hark, mortal!* By the third bell of the morn (08:00 sharp), thy Zammad Docker scroll must be writ, lest the ancient compilation demons devour thy soul.
